# Vendelux Raises $50M in Series B Funding

-

July 10, 2026

Vendelux, a NYC-based developer of an AI-powered B2B event intelligence and predictive marketing analytics platform, raised $50m in Series B funding.

The round was led by Tribeca Venture Partners with participation from S3 Ventures, Pelion Venture Partners, HubSpot Ventures, FirstMark Capital, and Cervin Ventures, bringing the company’s total capital raised to $71m.

The company intends to use the capital to deepen its core artificial intelligence infrastructure, accelerate product development to bridge marketers with event organizers, and expand its global corporate sales engineering divisions.

Led by Co-founder and CEO Alex Reynolds alongside Co-founder Stefan Fletcher, Vendelux develops an event intelligence layer engineered to map and track over 250,000 global B2B events, allowing sales and marketing teams to evaluate historical attendee density, identify active buyer cohorts, and automate qualified in-person meeting bookings.

BUILT WITH AI AT THE CORE

# Building the Intelligence Layer for In-Person GTM

Vendelux is an event intelligence platform that helps companies turn in-person events into a measurable, scalable growth channel.

Why Vendelux Exists

In-person events remain one of the largest line items in modern go-to-market budgets, but decisions about where to invest, who to engage, and how to measure impact have historically relied on incomplete data and manual effort.

Vendelux was built to change that by applying real-time attendee intelligence, coordinated execution, and clear attribution to the entire event lifecycle.

How Vendelux Works

Vendelux connects live event attendee data with intelligent workflows that help teams identify the right events, engage the right accounts, and measure outcomes across the GTM org.

By unifying event intelligence, outreach coordination, and revenue attribution in one platform, Vendelux enables teams to operate events as a repeatable system, not just a series of one-off campaigns.

# Vendelux Raises $50M Series B to Bring AI-led Intelligence to B2B Events

## 07.08.2026

Partner, FirstMark

When we led Vendelux’s Series A back in 2023, our conviction was simple: in-person events remain one of the highest-ROI channels in B2B go-to-market, and in a world of increasing digital noise, they would only increase in value.

Alex and Stefan had already built something remarkable: one of the largest event intelligence data repositories in existence, with tens of millions of data points spanning the world’s B2B events.

In the time since, the team has done something even more impressive: they’ve used AI to turn that data asset into something genuinely actionable, at a scale that simply wasn’t possible before.

What used to be a large dataset to support event marketers is now an intelligence and automation layer that helps marketing and sales teams identify the right events, find the right people to meet, and book meetings automatically and at scale. That shift, from data to an AI-native decision and matching engine, is the story of the last 18 months and has profoundly moved Vendelux into a “must own” in the AI-GTM stack.

The results speak for themselves. Vendelux now tracks more than 250,000 global B2B events, and thousands of marketing professionals rely on the platform to run programs that have influenced billions of dollars in event spend.
